resolution.quote:
I was unable to test https://github.com/moveit/moveit2_tutorials/pull/917 successfully on Rolling/main because there was an issue with sending duplicate time points to joint trajectory controllers with the Pilz move group sequence capability.

This PR fixes that, but I am not entirely sure this is the most efficient fix, as it would be preferable to package the trajectory correctly in the first place. But... this works.
